findings.title: Failed deliveries have no clear recovery step
findings.reason: The project can detect a failed delivery, but it does not name who restores service, where to start, or how to confirm recovery.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add the smallest owned recovery route for failed delivery and keep the existing acceptance boundary.

## Validation

- Run the focused delivery check
- Confirm the recovery owner and rollback result are recorded
expectedOutput: Give the next operator one owned recovery route and a focused check that confirms service is restored.
